acceptanceCriteria: A1: v0.2.25 version, documentation and parity rows are internally consistent before release verification.
A2: only a fresh immutable v0.2.25 public Release with all required assets is accepted.
A3: downloaded v0.2.25 binary passes isolated adopter and N-1 acceptance without source fallback.
A4: installed v0.2.25 accepts and records the append-only finalization transition.
A5: WI-202 failure and recovery, release identity, adopter evidence and tri-language Outcome are auditable.
goal: 在 origin/main 上建立可审计的 v0.2.25 发布、安装验收与 Runtime transition 兼容基线。
intent: 发布包含 append-only finalization transition 支持的 v0.2.25，并用该公开版本完成治理收尾。

scenarioCoverage.expected: All current release baselines resolve to v0.2.25.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run version consistency, documentation and hosted release checks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Downloaded v0.2.25 completes isolated adopter acceptance.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run tests/release/adopter_acceptance.sh against the published tag.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Installed v0.2.25 accepts a linked append-only transition.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the post-merge transition with the installed v0.2.25 binary.
